title: HR Ne 10 AM Aur 5 PM Diya: Ab Kya Dekhein?
cta: Reply se pehle reflect karo. Your Life, Decoded Hour by Hour.

shots.prompt: Young Indian man at a cafe table, reading his phone and pausing before replying; subtle camera push-in; soft side lighting; familiar, slightly tense mood.
shots.dialogue: HR ka message aaya: 10 AM or 5 PM?

shots.prompt: Single thumb hovering above the send button area of a phone with the screen deliberately out of focus; macro camera move; warm cafe light; suspended-decision mood.
shots.vo: Reply type karke main ruk gayi.

VedicHour mein interview select kiya, aur poore din ke 18 planetary hours ek grid mein aa gaye. Ek hora card khola toh seedha plain-English context mila: yeh window kis tarah ke kaam ko suit karti hai.
Koi outcome claim nahi, bas apni birth chart ke hisaab se timing ko reflect karne ka ek lens.
